title: kate-search: skip replace-all for an empty pattern
summary: replace_all returns an empty transaction when the plain, escape, or regex pattern is empty. An invalid escape still returns the error. The file has no test module yet.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: replace.rs has no test module. Add one module named tests at the end of the file. Put the test function in that module. Do not add a second mod tests. Add pattern_is_empty. Use this exact match. Pattern::Plain(text) returns Ok(text.is_empty()). Pattern::EscapeSequences(text) returns Ok(escape::expand_pattern(text)?.is_empty()). Use the ? operator on that line. Do not match Ok and Err by hand. Pattern::Regex(text) returns Ok(text.is_empty()). At the start of replace_all, write let empty = pattern_is_empty(q)?; then if empty { return Ok((Transaction::default(), 0)); }. Use the ? operator. Do not match the Result by hand. Do not touch find_all, find_next, pick_forward, pick_back, keep_disjoint, capture_names, or edits_overlap. The test an_empty_pattern_inserts_nothing uses the buffer abc and the replacement x. An empty Plain pattern returns count 0 and an empty transaction. An empty EscapeSequences pattern returns count 0 and an empty transaction. An empty Regex pattern returns count 0 and an empty transaction. The escape pattern backslash q returns Err. The plain pattern a and the replacement b still returns count 1. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: replace::tests::an_empty_pattern_inserts_nothing
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. An empty plain replace of abc with x inserts a copy at every scalar boundary. After the change the count is 0 and the transaction is empty. An empty escape and an empty regex do the same. The escape backslash q returns Err. The plain pattern a replaced by b still returns count 1.
